Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Nexa Health: usage spotlight sync & recording permission

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for agreeing to a customer spotlight. We'd love to schedule a 35-45 minute conversation to surface how your team uses Redwood Inference for model serving and the measurable win (latency/cost/reliability) you noticed. This will be used for a short case highlight on our site and social.

Proposed scope / agenda (30–40 minutes):
- 5 min intros and roles
- 10–15 min technical usage: deployment mode, model choices, perf numbers
- 10 min outcomes & metrics: cost/unit, latency, developer velocity
- 5–10 min quick Q&A and approval steps for the write-up

Recording: we usually record the call to capture quotes accurately and to make a 2–3 minute highlight clip. Attached is a one-page draft release for consent. If you're okay with recording and the release language we can proceed; if not, we can take detailed notes instead.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 30 Sep, 10:00–10:45
- Thu 01 Oct, 14:00–14:45
- Fri 02 Oct, 09:00–09:45

Stakeholders we were hoping to include: Jordan Price (Ops lead — Nexa), and your product engineering contact. On our side I'll join, and Marissa Cole (Customer Marketing) will be there to capture the story. Rishi can join to cover usage metrics.

Attachment: draft_release_form.pdf (PDF)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456

Would any of the above times work? If yes, which stakeholders should we include on the invite?

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
